# metronome_product (Resource)

A product: what a line of an invoice is for. A `USAGE` product prices a billable metric; a `FIXED` product is what a commit or a credit is sold as; a `SUBSCRIPTION` product is a recurring charge.

A product keeps a history. A change made here is added to it as an update that takes effect **from the start of the current hour** (Metronome wants an hour boundary), so usage already invoiced is not repriced.

~> **`type` cannot change**; changing it replaces the product.

~> **Destroying a product archives it.** Metronome has no delete, and an archived product cannot be restored. Rates that already name it keep working; no new rate can.

`COMPOSITE` and professional-service products are not supported by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Usage, priced by the hour from a metric that counts seconds.
resource "metronome_product" "awake" {
  name               = "Awake time"
  type               = "USAGE"
  billable_metric_id = metronome_billable_metric.awake_seconds.id
  quantity_conversion = {
    conversion_factor = 3600
    operation         = "DIVIDE"
  }
}

# What a commit or a credit is sold as.
resource "metronome_product" "credit" {
  name = "Credit"
  type = "FIXED"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name, shown on invoices. Changed in place.
- `type` (String) `USAGE`, `FIXED` or `SUBSCRIPTION`. Changing it replaces the product.

### Optional

- `billable_metric_id` (String) The billable metric a `USAGE` product prices. Required for `USAGE`, not allowed otherwise. Changed in place: the product meters with the new metric from the start of the current hour.
- `presentation_group_key` (List of String) For `USAGE` products: the group key of the metric by which usage is broken down on an invoice. Changed in place.
- `pricing_group_key` (List of String) For `USAGE` products: the group key of the metric by whose values the product is priced separately. Changed in place.
- `quantity_conversion` (Attributes) For `USAGE` products: converts the metric's quantity before it is priced, for example seconds to hours. Changed in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quantity_conversion))
- `quantity_rounding` (Attributes) For `USAGE` products: rounds the quantity (after conversion) before it is priced. Changed in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quantity_rounding))
- `tags` (List of String) Tags, by which commits and credits can be limited to some products. Changed in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The product's Metronome ID.

<a id="nestedatt--quantity_conversion"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quantity_conversion`

Required:

- `conversion_factor` (Number) What the quantity is multiplied or divided by.
- `operation` (String) `MULTIPLY` or `DIVIDE`.

Optional:

- `name` (String) A name for the conversion.


<a id="nestedatt--quantity_rounding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quantity_rounding`

Required:

- `decimal_places` (Number) How many decimal places to keep.
- `rounding_method` (String) `ROUND_UP`, `ROUND_DOWN` or `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import metronome_product.awake d7abd0cd-4ae9-4db7-8676-e986a4ebd8dc
```
